name: Housekeeping
overview: Housekeeping in Scripture is portrayed as a wise and purposeful practice that reflects order and care within God's created order. From the foundational act of God creating the heavens and the earth (Genesis 1:1) to the orderly arrangement of the Levites in the camp (Numbers 2:17), the Bible emphasizes purposeful structure and stewardship. Proverbs highlights the vital role of a wise woman who builds and nurtures her household, rising early to provide for her family (Proverbs 14:1; 31:15). Ultimately, the care and order within the home point toward the greater order and salvation found in Christ, who is the way, the truth, and the life (John 14:6), demonstrating that true life and purpose flow from God’s design.
